research_result.description: YouTube Transcript (TranscriptAPI) provides a REST API and native MCP server for extracting transcript content, searching YouTube, and gathering channel and playlist metadata.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can obtain access by registering for a free account at transcriptapi.com, which instantly provides 100 free credits without requiring a credit card, and copying their API key from the dashboard.

evidence.claim: TranscriptAPI provides access to video transcript data via a REST interface.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You get reliable, fast access to video text data through a clean REST interface.

evidence.claim: TranscriptAPI offers a native MCP server integration.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: TranscriptAPI has a native MCP server that works with Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT, and OpenClaw.

evidence.claim: TranscriptAPI provides a free self-serve tier with 100 credits without requiring a credit card.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Free tier: 100 credits to start. No credit card required. No time limit.

evidence.claim: Authentication is performed using an API key passed in the Authorization header.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The API key goes in the Authorization header, not in the URL.
